column7: This power bank is a beast! It charged my iPhone 13 four full times on a camping trip. High speed charging works flawlessly on both USB ports simultaneously.
Compact matte finish that fits in my backpack side pocket. Charges tablets and phones quickly with PowerIQ tech. Build quality is solid and sturdy.
Holds charge for weeks without self-draining. LED indicator gives clear battery percentage status. Highly recommended for heavy travelers.

column6: Great capacity but takes time to recharge
column7: Very high capacity and charges multiple gadgets. Only downside is recharging the power bank itself takes around 9-10 hours with micro-USB.
The 20000mAh capacity is great, but this brick is too heavy to carry in a pocket. Definitely meant for a backpack or purse only.
It weighs almost a pound. Good for long flights, but too bulky and heavy for carrying around in a jacket pocket.
People complaining about weight don't understand battery physics. For 20100mAh, the weight and slim tube form factor are very reasonable.
After 4 months of normal use, the battery swelling cracked open the plastic seam! Battery expanded like a pillow. Extremely dangerous fire hazard.
The battery pack started swelling and emitted a burning chemical smell during recharging. Had to immediately disconnect and place it outside.
Smoke started coming out of the second USB port while charging my phone! The port melted. Contacted customer service for emergency return.
